description:
Most populated servers right now. The online servers with the most players right now - the same query behind the rust.wiki Discord bot's
`/servers` command - as a compact list: `id`, `name`, `players`, `max_players`, `country` and the server's page
`url`. Use `/servers?sort=players` for the full records. Cached for 60 seconds.

country.description: Restrict to one ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country.

name: get_top_servers
title: Most populated servers right now
